description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Modal' which provides a reusable overlay modal dialog with customizable properties such as visibility, title, header offset, z-index layers, dimensions, footer, and styling. It manages accessibility, keyboard events (ESC to close), and uses React portals to render outside the normal DOM hierarchy.
